column1: Cook the macaroni in lightly salted boiling water until just tender. Drain well and transfer to a large bowl.
Cut the cauliflower and broccoli into small florets. Peel the broccoli stem and slice it too.
Heat a large skillet with a little oil. Squeeze the sausage meat out of its casing in small balls straight into the pan and fry until golden and cooked through.
Add the garlic near the end of frying, then tip the sausage into the bowl with the macaroni.
Reheat the skillet and quickly sear the cauliflower and broccoli in a little oil over high heat, seasoning with salt and pepper. Work in two or three batches if needed.
Mix the vegetables into the macaroni.
Bring the milk to a boil, turn off the heat and stir in the parmesan, blue cheese and grated cheese until melted.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper, pour it over the macaroni mixture and fold everything together.
Grease a baking dish (or several individual dishes) with butter or oil. Add the macaroni mixture and sprinkle with breadcrumbs.
Dot the top with small pieces of butter and bake at 425°F (220°C) for about 20 minutes, until golden.
